python3 -I -c '
# After Claude creates/edits a file under BookNest/booknest/: record it for review and run the static checks.
import json, os, subprocess, sys
project = os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR") or os.getcwd()
app = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(project, "BookNest", "booknest"))
try:
    event = json.load(sys.stdin)
except ValueError:
    sys.exit(0)
path = (event.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or (event.get("tool_response") or {}).get("filePath") or ""
if not path:
    sys.exit(0)
path = os.path.realpath(path if os.path.isabs(path) else os.path.join(event.get("cwd") or project, path))
if not path.startswith(app + os.sep) or "/.venv/" in path or "/__pycache__/" in path:
    sys.exit(0)
pending = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TMPDIR", "/tmp"), "booknest-review-pending-" + event.get("session_id", "default"))
with open(pending, "a") as f:
    f.write(path + "\n")
checks = os.path.join(project, ".claude", "skills", "booknest-review", "scripts", "static_checks.sh")
run = subprocess.run(["bash", checks, app], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
report = (run.stdout + run.stderr).strip()
broken = "== Python compiles\nok" not in report
if len(report) > 6000:
    report = report[:6000] + "\n... (truncated)"
rel = os.path.relpath(path, project)
head = "booknest-review static checks after editing " + rel + (" - PYTHON DOES NOT COMPILE, fix this first." if broken else " (candidates only; confirm any hit by reading the code).")
print(json.dumps({
    "systemMessage": "booknest-review checks ran for " + rel + (" - compile error!" if broken else ""),
    "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": head + "\n\n" + report},
}))
'

python3 -I -c '
# When Claude is about to finish: if BookNest files changed this turn, keep going once and run the booknest-review skill.
# stop_hook_active is true on the follow-up stop, so a review that edits code cannot loop forever.
import json, os, sys
project = os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR") or os.getcwd()
try:
    event = json.load(sys.stdin)
except ValueError:
    sys.exit(0)
pending = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TMPDIR", "/tmp"), "booknest-review-pending-" + event.get("session_id", "default"))
try:
    with open(pending) as f:
        paths = sorted({line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()})
    os.remove(pending)
except FileNotFoundError:
    sys.exit(0)
if not paths or event.get("stop_hook_active"):
    sys.exit(0)
rel = [os.path.relpath(p, project) for p in paths]
print(json.dumps({
    "systemMessage": "booknest-review requested for " + str(len(rel)) + " changed file(s)",
    "decision": "block",
    "reason": "BookNest files were created or changed this turn:\n"
              + "\n".join("- " + p for p in rel)
              + "\n\nInvoke the booknest-review skill (Skill tool, skill \"booknest-review\") scoped to these files"
              + " (args: " + " ".join(rel) + ") and report the findings before finishing.",
}))
'
